show.description: A powerful man living a hidden double life crosses paths with a struggling woman forced into a dangerous situation. What begins as a deal turns into an unexpected marriage, pulling them into a web of crime, political power, and deadly enemies. As secrets unfold, love and survival collide in a high-stakes game where one truth can change everything
